 Dated this the 29th day of October, 2025  JUDGMENT

The above Writ Petition (C) is filed with the following prayers:
"i. Call for the records pertaining to the issuance of Ext.P6 demolition order and issue a Writ of Certiorari or any other appropriate writ or order quashing Exhibit.P6 order . ii.

To dispense with English translation of the documents Exts.P5 & Ext.P6 in vernacular language, iii. issue such other reliefs which may deem fit and proper on the facts and circumstances of the case;
iv. Allow this writ petition ( Civil) Costs."
[SIC]
2. The main prayer in this Writ Petition (C) is against Ext.P6 demolition order.

When this Writ Petition (C) came up for consideration, on 04.04.2025, this Court passed the following order:
" The learned Standing Counsel takes notice for respondents 1 and 2. Issue notice by speed post to the 3rd respondent.
The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner was not issued with any notice prior to the passing of Ext.P6 order.
This is recorded.

In view of the above, there shall be an interim order as prayed for, for a period of two months."
3.
The Registry reported that no process is paid for issuing notice to 3rd respondent.

The petitioner obtained an order on 04.04.2025, and even now, he is enjoying the stay order without paying the process for issuing notice to the 3rd respondent; therefore, I am not inclined to extend the stay.

2 4.
This Court perused the impugned order.
It is a demolition notice.
If the petitioner has any grievance against Ext.P6, the petitioner can submit the objection to the Panchayath, and there can be a direction to consider the same.
Till then, the interim order can continue.

Therefore, this Writ Petition (C) is disposed of with the following directions:
1.

The petitioner is free to submit his objection to Ext.P6 to the 2nd respondent,
within three weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment.

2. If such a representation is received, the 2 nd respondent will consider the same and pass 2025:KER:81964 WP(C) NO.14002 OF 2025 appropriate orders, after giving an opportunity of hearing to the petitioner and the 3rd respondent.
If the objection is submitted as directed above, further proceedings based on Ext.P6 shall be kept in abeyance till final orders are passed in the objection.
